python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
base = Path(".")
source = json.loads((base / "source-lock.json").read_text())["sourceFiles"]
page_path = "apps/prototype/src/scenarios/bm-b/page.tsx"
contract_path = "apps/prototype/src/scenarios/bm-b/state-contract.md"
page = (base / page_path).read_text()
pattern = r'    <header className="mb-rain-16" data-rain-id="local-rn14-bm-b-context">[\s\S]*?    </header>\n'
baseline, count = re.subn(pattern, "", page)
assert count == 1, "Expected exactly one new native context header"
assert hashlib.sha256(baseline.encode()).hexdigest() == source[page_path], "Existing page content changed"
assert "教材共建 · 第三周" in page and "虚构教学示例" in page
assert re.search(pattern + r"    <Card>", page), "Context must directly precede existing Card"
contract = (base / contract_path).read_text()
replacements = [
("本地副本说明：以下取消与丢弃条目跟随当前 `page.tsx` 已有的 AlertDialog 脏草稿确认实现，仅校正副本合同，原仓库不变。\n\n", ""),
("| 保存中 | 禁用字段、附件和提交；重复提交忽略；取消、关闭、Escape 被拦截 |", "| 保存中 | 禁用字段、附件和提交；重复提交忽略；取消、关闭、Escape/遮罩被拦截 |"),
("| 取消/关闭/Escape | 保存中被拦截；无改动时直接关闭；有脏草稿时拦截关闭并打开 AlertDialog，默认焦点进入“继续编辑” |", "| 取消/关闭/Escape/遮罩 | 保存中之外均丢弃草稿，中止全部未完成上传，不另加确认弹窗 |"),
("| 遮罩点击 | 当前 Dialog.Root 默认 `disablePointerDismissal=true`，本场景未覆盖；点击遮罩不关闭教材编辑，也不触发丢弃或脏草稿确认 |\n", ""),
("| 脏草稿确认 | “继续编辑”仅关闭确认框并保留草稿；“放弃修改”恢复已保存教材、中止全部未完成上传并关闭教材编辑 |\n", ""),
("| 移除/丢弃草稿/卸载 |", "| 移除/关闭/卸载 |"),
("脏草稿须确认后才丢弃；", "取消是明确丢弃；"),
]
for current, previous in replacements:
    assert contract.count(current) == 1, current
    contract = contract.replace(current, previous, 1)
assert hashlib.sha256(contract.encode()).hexdigest() == source[contract_path], "Unrelated contract content changed"
unchanged = ["apps/prototype/src/scenarios/bm-b/page.css", "apps/prototype/src/scenarios/bm-b/state.ts"]
for path in unchanged:
    assert hashlib.sha256((base / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == source[path], path + " changed"
print(json.dumps({"status": "passed", "page_change": "one native context header only", "contract_change": "discard and backdrop behavior corrections only", "unchanged": unchanged, "sha256": {p: hashlib.sha256((base / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [page_path, contract_path]}}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
PY
